items.source:
Read full annotation metadata for the underlying class,
including metadata for annotated methods.
items.translation: 读取底层类的完整注解元数据，包括已注解方法的元数据。

items.source: Read basic class metadata for the underlying class.
items.translation: 读取底层类的基本类元数据。

items.source: Return the resource reference for the class file.
items.translation: 返回类文件的资源引用。

items.source: Simple facade for accessing class metadata, as read by an ASM ClassReader.
items.translation: 用于访问类元数据的简单 Facade，其读取方式与 ASM 的ClassReader一致。
